issues.suggestion: Ensure components are organized logically and parallel processing is utilized where possible

issues.message: Verify data types match source system
issues.suggestion: Review DML to ensure decimal precision, string lengths, and date formats are correct

issues.message: Partitioning configuration not visible in MP file
issues.suggestion:
Review graph properties:
  • For sorted rollup: 2-8 partitions (parallel processing)
  • For in-memory rollup: 1-2 partitions (maximize memory per partition)
  • Consider data volume and system resources
  • Maintain partition preservation where possible

issues.message: Review partition flow to avoid unnecessary repartitioning
issues.suggestion: Use 'Same' partitioning to preserve partitions between components when possible

issues.message: Join components not detected in MP file
issues.suggestion:
If graph contains joins, ensure:
  • Join keys are indexed/sorted
  • Smaller datasets joined first
  • Appropriate join type selected
  • Partition compatibility verified
  • Consider lookup alternatives for small reference data

Ensure adequate logging for troubleshooting: record counts, error messages, timing information
Good practice: Parameterization enables environment-independent deployment
